updateRequirements.title: Update Requirements
updateRequirements.description:
This online tool allows authorized users to easily and transparently submit information about potential updates required to the heavy rainfall hazard map. Its primary purpose is to capture local knowledge and changes that may not yet have been taken into account in the underlying data or calculations.

Examples of information that can be reported include:

  • Missing or newly constructed culverts, pipelines or bridge structures,

  • Changes in flow directions resulting from terrain modifications, construction work or new traffic routes,

  • Changes to ditches, depressions, drainage facilities or watercourses,

  • Local observations concerning known flood paths and low-lying areas,

  • Information about implausible or incomplete representations on the map
Reports can be submitted directly via the map. The relevant location can be marked and supplemented with a description. Where available, additional information such as photographs, plans or details about local conditions can also be attached (one file can be uploaded directly, with additional files provided via an upload link if required).

All incoming reports are subject to a technical review. They do not automatically result in changes to the heavy rainfall hazard map but may be taken into account when prioritizing reviews, data collection and future updates. To report changes in damage potential, please use the "Building Damage Potential" portal.
